name: refhaven
description: Private Git comparisons, history, blame, and stash inspection with local processing.
author: Patrizio Filloramo

untrustedWorkspaces.description: RefHaven runs local Git commands and requires a trusted workspace.

commands.title: Compare Stash File with Working Tree
Open Issue or Merge Request in Browser...

refhaven.inlineBlame.enabled.description: Show blame for the current line as dimmed inline text at the end of the line.

refhaven.statusBarBlame.enabled.description: Show blame for the current line in the status bar.

refhaven.lineHover.enabled.description: Show rich local commit and diff details when hovering a file line.

refhaven.browserLinks.approvedOrigins.description: Optional strict allowlist of exact HTTP(S) browser origins. Leave empty to use validated origins inferred from local repository remotes. Configure entries such as https://gitlab.company.example:8443 for policy enforcement or custom browser ports; paths and credentials are not allowed.

enumDescriptions: Detect the URL shape from the remote hostname.
refhaven.browserLinks.hostGrammar.description: Which URL shape browser links use. Detection reads the remote hostname only and never contacts the host, so a self-hosted instance on a custom hostname may be detected as GitLab; set this explicitly when links open the wrong page.

enumDescriptions: Do not annotate the whole file.
Show author, commit age, summary, and hover details for every line.
Color lines by the age of their last commit.
refhaven.fileAnnotations.mode.description: Whole-file annotation mode. Changes-relative-to-ref annotations are selected from the command palette and retained in this workspace.

enumDescriptions: Show the author and relative commit age.
Show the author, relative commit age, and bounded commit summary.
refhaven.fileAnnotations.blame.format.description: Information shown by whole-file blame annotations. Full commit details remain available on hover.

refhaven.fileAnnotations.blame.showRepea.description: Repeat blame details on every line in a contiguous commit block. When disabled, RefHaven groups the block visually and shows details on its first line.

enumDescriptions: Show a compact color strip at the right edge of each editor line.
Show the file-wide age distribution in the overview ruler.
Tint the complete editor line with a translucent background.

refhaven.fileAnnotations.heatmap.locatio.description: Where the file heatmap is rendered. Edge and overview keep code readable; add line for a stronger full-line visualization.

enumDescriptions: Toggle the heatmap only for the active file.
Toggle the persisted annotation mode for the VS Code window.
refhaven.fileAnnotations.heatmap.toggleM.description: Scope used by Toggle File Heatmap. File scope avoids changing unrelated editors; window scope persists the mode globally.

refhaven.git.timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum duration in seconds for an individual Git command.
